notes.title: 🏰 Patch 0.5.1
notes.notes:
[b]Medieval Patch 1[/b]
The Medieval Era's first patch is here. It brings more Developments for your cities, new Steam features, and a few mechanical changes to improve the game's balance. The update also marks the official launch of the [url=https://roguehex.wiki.gg/wiki/Rogue_Hex_Wiki]Rogue Hex community wiki[/url]. Let's jump in.

✨ [b]Features[/b]
• 7 new Developments: Armory, Glassworks, Parapets, Buttress, Garrison, Strider, Round Table
• New Trait: Anatomizer
• New Card: Re-Engage
◦ [i]Cheers @Eerokah & @MelficeBelmont[/i]
• New Cards: Wrath, Volley
• New cloud shader
• Improved UI for drafting panels
• Reduced game build size
• Improved performance
• Steam Cloud Save
• Steam Achievements
• [url=https://roguehex.wiki.gg/wiki/Rogue_Hex_Wiki]Rogue Hex Wiki[/url] launch

⚖️ [b]Changes[/b]
• Cards now go into the "Play Pile" when you play them. All cards in the Play Pile are discarded at the end of your turn.
◦ This change aims to balance powerful draw abilities like Spark and Teapot that were creating infinites too easily. It also creates fun opportunities for new cards that interact with the Play Pile such as Volley.
[i]◦ Shoutout to @Dp101, @MelficeBelmont, @PuszekSE, @RabbitOfCaernabog, @JeBus, @Stardust974, @DemonLLama, @Arthune, and everyone else who contributed to the discussion on Discord![/i]
• Some cards now remove obsolete versions from the Library when you discover them For example, discovering Hoplite removes Warrior.
[i]◦ Thanks @Deee and @PuszekSE[/i]
• Improved City focus panel with more info
• Migrants now gives an Inhabit+ instead of increasing the nearest city’s Population
• Added 1 Labour cost to durable strategic resource cards (IE Lumber, Jerky…)
• Unit tooltips now display Max Health and Piercing.
• Changed Frame Cap setting to a new VSync toggle.
• Cities are now smarter about offering you useful Developments to choose from.
[i]◦ Arigato @Dp101[/i]

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
• Potential fix for d3d11 texture crashes (VSync)
[i]◦ Huge thanks to @Chitt411[/i]
• Charms now work during multiple rounds without restarting the app
[i]◦ Thanks @Carneggy[/i]
• Fixed edge cases that could prevent achievements from unlocking
[i]◦ Shoutout @Dp101[/i]
• Fixed scroll bar issue when clicking between units with lots of actions
[i]◦ Cheers @Arthune[/i]
• Traits that upgrade skills are no longer abusable via Undo
• Magic Pencil charm is now safe to use
[i]◦ Thanks to @Niemand[/i]

Cheers to all the knights in our community helping to test the Medieval era.

The Renaissance era is up next...
Go [url=https://discord.com/invite/TWeJB3sgNG]join the Discord[/url] so that you can play it early!

⚔️✨

notes.title: 🏛️ The Classic Update
notes.notes:
[b]Salve and welcome to the Classic Update![/b]
With over 2x the content, the new demo offers an hour+ of gameplay per run.

✨ [b]Features[/b]
• Welcome to the Classical Era
• Explore 30 new technologies
• Introducing Barbara, the barbarian leader
• Barbarians are smarter & stronger
• New mechanic: Sentry
• New mechanic: Flanking
• Pay gold to upgrade obsolete units and buildings
• New & improved wonders
• Build roads to connect your cities
• Unit stat: Piercing
• Upgraded GUI art & effects
• Improved fog of war tile texture
• Five new Units
• Seven new Developments
• Twelve new Buildings
• Six new Relics
• Ten new Traits
• Dozens of new Cards
• Control Villages with your city for bonus resources
• Level up your leader to unlock new cards and relics
• Complete achievements to earn Quirks

⚖️ [b]Changes[/b]
• Cavalry class units are now Tanks, slow & strong armored units
• Anti-cavalry class units are now Anti-Armor units
• Reworked Spearman into Hoplite
• Tile resources give bonuses when controlled by your cities
• Scouts may now attack with 3 base damage
• Wonders are now unique
• Rebalanced city growth levels
• Temporarily disabled the undo button. It will return.
• New relic icons
• Improved Achievements
• Upgraded (meta progression) Upgrades
• Too many card balance changes to list…

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]
• Fixed a ton of soft locks and crashes.
    Heads up: rare locks & crashes might still happen.
• Solved a bug that prevented achievements from unlocking after the first game in each session
• Developments now save & load correctly
• Completing actions you can’t afford is no longer possible
• Movement and vision modifiers now save & load
• You can no longer spam to force multiple attacks
• Undoing card draw now works as expected
• Settler cost now resets correctly if you undo playing the card
• Tooltips hidden behind other objects can no longer activate
• Removed a 1px gap at the top of the GUI
• Breaking changes automatically clear affected save files
• Camera pan locks when the application is minimized or a menu is open

[b]And we're just getting started...[/b]
Be sure to join our Discord community so that you can be the first to try the Medieval era!

⚔️✨
Reed
